milestones.title: The Day We First Met
milestones.description: The very first moments together after birth, tiny hands, sleepy eyes, and a whole new world beginning.

milestones.title: Coming Home
milestones.description: Leaving the hospital and bringing baby home for the first time, introducing them to their new nest.

milestones.title: Our First Family Portrait
milestones.description: The first photo with everyone together, imperfect, tired, but full of love.

milestones.title: That First Real Smile
milestones.description: The first time baby smiles back and it feels like the whole room lights up.

milestones.title: First Giggles
milestones.description: When a silly face or funny sound turns into uncontrollable baby giggles.

milestones.title: Finding Their Voice
milestones.description: Those early coos, babbles, and little sounds that start to fill the house.

milestones.title: The Tummy Time Champion
milestones.description: The moment they start lifting their head and looking around like a tiny explorer.

milestones.title: Rolling Over
milestones.description: The first time they surprise everyone by rolling over on their own.

milestones.title: Grabbing the World
milestones.description: When they reach out and grab a toy—or your finger—with serious determination.

milestones.title: Sitting Up Like a Boss
milestones.description: That proud moment when they sit up without toppling over right away.

milestones.title: On the Move
milestones.description: The day they start crawling and suddenly no corner of the room is safe.

milestones.title: First Little Tooth
milestones.description: The arrival of the very first tooth, with all the drool and chewing that comes with it.

milestones.title: Almost Words
milestones.description: Those funny almost-words that only family understands but everyone adores.

milestones.title: First Holiday Together
milestones.description: Baby’s first big celebration with family traditions, outfits, and way too many photos.

milestones.title: Sleeping Through the Night
milestones.description: That legendary night when everyone finally gets some real sleep.

milestones.title: First Wobbly Steps
milestones.description: The unforgettable moment they let go, wobble forward, and walk into waiting arms.

milestones.title: Catch Me If You Can
milestones.description: When walking turns into running and suddenly they are faster than you expected.

milestones.title: First Real Word
milestones.description: The first clear word that makes everyone stop and cheer.

milestones.title: Tiny Conversations
milestones.description: When they start putting words together and their personality starts spilling out.

milestones.title: The ‘No’ Era
milestones.description: The phase where ‘no’ becomes a favorite word and independence starts to shine.

milestones.title: The Chosen Toy
milestones.description: That one toy, blanket, or stuffed animal that must go everywhere with them.

milestones.title: First Dance Party
milestones.description: When a song comes on and they start dancing like nobody’s watching.

milestones.title: Messy Self-Feeding
milestones.description: The beginning of feeding themselves—more food on the floor than in the mouth.

milestones.title: First Masterpiece
milestones.description: Their first scribble or drawing proudly claimed as art.

milestones.title: Make-Believe Adventures
milestones.description: When everyday objects become rockets, castles, and secret hideouts.

milestones.title: Potty Hero Begins
milestones.description: The start of saying goodbye to diapers and celebrating every tiny victory.

milestones.title: First Little Friend
milestones.description: The first buddy they talk about constantly and look for at playtime.

milestones.title: Conquering the Playground
milestones.description: Slides, swings, and the day they finally go down on their own.

milestones.title: Night at Grandparents’ House
milestones.description: Their first night away, full of stories, treats, and extra cuddles.

milestones.title: First Day of Preschool
milestones.description: Tiny backpack, nervous smile, and a big step into a new world of friends and stories.

milestones.title: First Day of ‘Big School’
milestones.description: The moment they officially become a school kid, full of excitement and questions.

milestones.title: First Best School Friend
milestones.description: The friend whose name you hear every single day after school.

milestones.title: Show and Tell Star
milestones.description: The day they bring a special object to school and proudly share its story.

milestones.title: Costume Day Magic
milestones.description: Dressing up as a hero, princess, or creature and living the part all day long.

milestones.title: Reading Their First Story
milestones.description: When they read (or pretend to read) a whole little book by themselves.

milestones.title: Writing Their Own Name
milestones.description: Those shaky letters that spell their name for the very first time.

milestones.title: Imaginary Worlds
milestones.description: Invented lands, invisible friends, and endless make-believe adventures.

milestones.title: Big Questions, Tiny Voice
milestones.description: The day they ask a surprisingly deep question about life, the world, or the stars.

milestones.title: Little Helper at Home
milestones.description: Proudly helping with chores, even if it takes twice as long.

milestones.title: First Little Sports Day
milestones.description: Their first time in a sports class, team, or activity, full of energy and enthusiasm.

milestones.title: On Stage for the First Time
milestones.description: Whether singing, dancing, or just standing there, it’s a standing-ovation moment.

milestones.title: First Lost Tooth
milestones.description: A wiggly tooth, a little gap, and maybe a visit from a special tooth fairy.

milestones.title: First Sleepover with a Friend
milestones.description: Pajamas, whispered secrets, and staying up later than they should.

milestones.title: New School Year, New Adventures
milestones.description: A fresh school year with a bigger backpack, new classmates, and fresh hopes.

milestones.title: Discovering a Favorite Subject
milestones.description: The moment a school subject clicks and they can’t stop talking about it.

milestones.title: The Big School Project
milestones.description: Posters, glue, late-night finishing touches, and proud presentation day.

milestones.title: Proud Report Card Moments
milestones.description: A school report that makes everyone smile and celebrate their hard work.

milestones.title: Joining a Team
milestones.description: First time wearing a team jersey and playing together for a shared goal.

milestones.title: First Goal, Point, or Medal
milestones.description: A moment of victory—scoring, winning, or simply finishing a race.

milestones.title: Finding Their Crowd
milestones.description: The group of friends they laugh, play, and grow with every day.

milestones.title: Learning to Make Up
milestones.description: Their first big disagreement with a friend and the lesson of saying sorry.

milestones.title: A New Passion Appears
milestones.description: Discovering a hobby—art, music, coding, reading—that they keep coming back to.

milestones.title: Camp Stories and Adventures
milestones.description: First camp or day trip filled with new activities, friends, and stories to tell.

milestones.title: Trusted with Responsibilities
milestones.description: Being given regular tasks at home and taking them seriously (most of the time).

milestones.title: Their First Gadget
milestones.description: Getting their first watch, tablet, console, or shared device and feeling very grown-up.

milestones.title: First Trip They Remember Clearly
milestones.description: A family trip or holiday that stays vivid in their memory.

milestones.title: Quiet Acts of Kindness
milestones.description: A moment they help someone else just because it feels right.

milestones.title: New Halls, New Chapter
milestones.description: Starting middle or secondary school with new teachers, bigger buildings, and more independence.

milestones.title: The Teen Crew
milestones.description: A close group of friends that become their everyday world.

milestones.title: First Crush Butterflies
milestones.description: The first time someone makes their heart race and their words stumble.

milestones.title: Dances, Parties, and School Nights
milestones.description: First school dance, party, or big social event they’ll talk about for weeks.

milestones.title: Finding Their Style
milestones.description: Changing hairstyles, outfits, and looks as they start to define who they are.

milestones.title: The Big Exam Season
milestones.description: Late-night studying, worries, and the relief when it’s finally over.

milestones.title: First Taste of Work
milestones.description: Babysitting, small jobs, or early work experiences that earn their own money.

milestones.title: Behind the Wheel
milestones.description: First driving lesson or moment in the driver’s seat, full of excitement and nerves.

milestones.title: Helping Beyond Home
milestones.description: Volunteering or helping in the community and realizing they can make a difference.

milestones.title: Creating Something of Their Own
milestones.description: Starting a project, club, channel, or creative work that feels truly theirs.

milestones.title: First Heartbreak
milestones.description: A tough goodbye or breakup that hurts but helps them grow.

milestones.title: Trip Without Parents
milestones.description: Traveling with friends, school, or a group, and tasting real independence.

milestones.title: Graduation Day
milestones.description: Caps, gowns, photos, and the feeling that one chapter is closing and another begins.

milestones.title: Moving Into Their Own Place
milestones.description: Boxes, keys, and the first home that’s truly theirs (even if it’s tiny).

milestones.title: First Day at University or Training
milestones.description: A new campus, new city, or new path, full of possibility.

milestones.title: First Real Job
milestones.description: First day at a real job, new colleagues, and that first paycheck feeling.

milestones.title: Buying Something Big
milestones.description: Their first big purchase they paid for themselves—phone, computer, vehicle, or furniture.

milestones.title: First Serious Relationship
milestones.description: A relationship that feels steady, meaningful, and part of their future plans.

milestones.title: Hosting Their Own Dinner
milestones.description: Inviting people over and cooking a meal in their own space.

milestones.title: Adventure on Their Own Terms
milestones.description: Planning and taking a trip they organized and paid for themselves.

milestones.title: Figuring Out Their Path
milestones.description: Moments of clarity where they start to see what they want from life.

milestones.title: Meeting Someone Special
milestones.description: The beginning of a story with someone who becomes very important in their life.

milestones.title: Building a Home Together
milestones.description: Moving in with a partner and creating a shared space and routine.

milestones.title: The Engagement Story
milestones.description: The question, the ‘yes’, and all the emotions around it.

milestones.title: Wedding Day
milestones.description: Promises, celebrations, and the start of a new family chapter.

milestones.title: First Year Together
milestones.description: Looking back at the first year of marriage or partnership and how far they’ve come.
